verdict.rationale: Hoppscotch supports environment variables and secret variables in environments, plus MCP/CLI access to environments, implying multi-environment switching capability. However, there's no explicit documentation describing named dev/staging/prod environment sets or a UI switcher mechanism for toggling between them. Missing for 10: explicit docs on creating/naming multiple environments (dev/staging/prod) and switching between them in the request flow, independent hands-on confirmation of this specific workflow.
